summary_en: 11,963,300 shares (8.9% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled effective 2026-09-07. Post-cancellation issued share count: 121,966,500.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Calbee resolved on 2026-08-28 to cancel 11,963,300 treasury shares (ordinary shares) effective 2026-09-07 pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation represents 8.9% of issued shares outstanding prior to the cancellation. Following the cancellation, total issued shares (excluding treasury) will be 121,966,500.
